notablePrerequisites:
Livio does not have summoning sickness.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{W}{W}{W}.
description:
Activate up to seven mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Livio's first ability twice by paying {2}{W}{W}, exiling Great Whale and Village Bell-Ringer with aegis counters on them.
Activate Livio's second ability by paying {2}{W} and tapping it, returning Great Whale and Village Bell-Ringer from exile to the battlefield.
Village Bell-Ringer and Great Whale enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Resolve the Village Bell-Ringer trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
